# ASPEC Entity Contributor Licence Agreement

**Version 1.0 (draft)**

This Entity Contributor Licence Agreement (the **Agreement**) is between the legal entity named in the acceptance statement (**You**) and **ASPEC RACING PTY LTD** (ABN 41 676 208 227), an Australian proprietary company (**ASPEC**, **We** or **Us**). It is accepted for You by the individual signatory identified by the GitHub account that accepts it (the **Signatory**).

It covers Contributions Submitted on Your behalf by Your Authorised Contributors to any project that ASPEC owns or manages and that refers to this Agreement (each a **Project**). You keep the copyright in Your Contributions. This Agreement gives ASPEC a licence to use them.

## 1. Definitions

1.1 **Legal Entity** means a company, partnership, trust, government body or any other person who is not a natural person.

1.2 **Affiliate** means any Legal Entity that Controls You, is Controlled by You or is under common Control with You. **Control** means direct or indirect power to direct management and policies, whether by contract or otherwise, ownership of 50% or more of the voting securities, or beneficial ownership of the entity.

1.3 **Authorised Contributor** means an individual (usually an employee or contractor) whom You have authorised to Submit Contributions on Your behalf, and who is recorded by ASPEC as covered by this Agreement. The record is made under the list You give ASPEC, as updated by notice from You from time to time (Schedule 1).

1.4 **Contribution** means any original work of authorship Submitted to a Project by an Authorised Contributor on Your behalf, or in which You or Your Affiliates own or assert Copyright. It includes source code, documentation, designs, images and other material, and changes to existing material. Something marked clearly in writing as "Not a Contribution" at the time it is Submitted is excluded.

1.5 **Submit**, **Copyright** and **Effective Date** have the meanings given in the ASPEC Individual Contributor Licence Agreement, applied to You and Your Authorised Contributors.

1.6 **Patent Claims** means any patent claims that You or Your Affiliates own or control now or later, and that would be infringed by making, using, selling or otherwise dealing in a Contribution, alone or combined with the Project it was Submitted to. [LEGAL REVIEW: Harmony makes the Affiliates' inclusion optional.]

## 2. Licence grants

2.1 **Ownership.** You (and Your Affiliates, as applicable) keep ownership of the Copyright in the Contributions.

2.2 **Copyright licence.** You grant ASPEC, and You procure that Your Affiliates grant ASPEC, a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free and fee-free licence under the Copyright in each Contribution. ASPEC may transfer it and may sublicense it through multiple tiers. It covers using, reproducing, modifying, adapting, translating, publicly displaying, publicly performing, communicating to the public, distributing and commercially exploiting the Contribution. This applies to the Contribution on its own and as part of any other work, in any form or medium.

2.3 **Relicensing.** Without limiting clause 2.2, ASPEC may license, sublicense or distribute any Contribution, and any work that includes it, under any terms ASPEC chooses. These include open-source, source-available, proprietary and commercial licences, with or without charge.

2.4 **Patent licence.** You grant ASPEC, and everyone who receives a Project or Contribution from ASPEC directly or indirectly, a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence under the Patent Claims. It allows them to make, have made, use, sell, offer to sell, import and otherwise transfer the Contribution, and the Project combined with it. ASPEC may sublicense and transfer this licence.

2.5 **Moral rights.** You will obtain, from each individual author of a Contribution, that author's genuine written consent for the purposes of Part IX of the *Copyright Act 1968* (Cth) and corresponding laws elsewhere. The consent must be in the terms of clause 2.5 of the ASPEC Individual Contributor Licence Agreement, and You must obtain it before the Contribution is Submitted. [LEGAL REVIEW: an entity cannot consent on behalf of its employees. Confirm the mechanism, for example consents in employment contracts.]

2.6 **No obligation; reserved rights.** ASPEC does not have to use any Contribution. You keep all rights not expressly granted.

## 3. Your confirmations

You confirm that:

(a) the Signatory is authorised to bind You, and You have the power to enter into this Agreement;

(b) You and Your Affiliates own, or otherwise have enough rights in, each Contribution to grant the licences in clause 2;

(c) neither You nor any Affiliate has granted, or will grant, rights in a Contribution that conflict with this Agreement;

(d) each Authorised Contributor is authorised by You to Submit Contributions on Your behalf, and You will notify ASPEC promptly in writing when an individual stops being an Authorised Contributor;

(e) any part of a Contribution that is not original to You, Your Affiliates or Your Authorised Contributors will be identified when it is Submitted, together with its source and any licence or other restrictions that apply.

## 4. Disclaimer, liability and general terms

Clauses 4 (Disclaimer), 5 (Limitation of liability) and 6 (General) of the ASPEC Individual Contributor Licence Agreement, version 1.0, apply to this Agreement as if set out in full, with references to "You" being references to the entity. [LEGAL REVIEW: consider setting these out in full rather than incorporating them by reference.]

## 5. Verification

The Agreement takes effect when the Signatory accepts it. However, ASPEC will treat Contributions as covered by it only after ASPEC has verified the Signatory's authority and the list of Authorised Contributors to its reasonable satisfaction. ASPEC may ask for evidence, such as a signed copy of this Agreement on Your letterhead.
